## What it is

Number 4, rendered orange. Back-right, 45°. Recessed 4. Three hooks. Not the start of the coil.

## Design notes

- Print it on its side, flat face down. The C is the layer outline.
- The foot is the same 6.0 × 3.2 mm tab. The 4 is recessed into the top face of the rib.
- The neck is 6 mm, with a 3 mm fillet each side where it leaves the rib.

```toml
[part]
min_wall = 1.0
```

## Don't

- Don't print it standing up.
- Don't put it on slot 1, 2, or 3. The tab will fit, and the hooks will be on the wrong heights. The number is the only key.
